regions.merged_text: Several years ago and frequently later on, I was assured that one of the great factors in the financial success of "old-man Rockefellow" was often attributed to his having kept a promise to spend something like 10% of his profits to one or other charitable work. I am quite inclined to take stock in such a report. I have seen the like work out in other cases. Plese pardon my prolongation of this conclusion. I meant to close in just a line or two here.

regions.merged_text: Just another case of: "The more hury the less speed". God help us. I was just looking for something else - a copy of that letter I was writing to the big policeman, MeClellan of Detr't and that I wanted to "point up a little" - and I find two of the above and bothe marked "copy". So I must conclude that you never received either. I need no further excuse for tardiness this time - and perhaps more to be regretted of something less or more regrettable ?!?!? Thank the dear Lord for mistaks too. And thank Him that its not ten-times worse. Possibly the delay may to havebeen a salutary one. Please God it may not be other.
